liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodeloo** (1 review): Garcia gets so worked up in his second solo that he misses the mic for the next verse [6]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Ordinary until the ending; around 7:30 Weir plays some great chords and things get interesting [6]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 other source): The first 6:48 comes from the Neumann SM69 source, shnid 21480, taped by Greg Schug and others [2]
- **Black Peter** (1 other source): A 13-second patch comes from the Neumann SM69 source, shnid 21480 [2]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-12-27.136705.sbd-aud.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 165 min [1]. Said about its sound: The soundboard source is not of stellar quality; a lower-generation, more complete version is hoped for [1]
- **gd1978-12-27.145346.sony.ecm270.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 20 songs; 173 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd78-12-27.sbd.wiley.9480.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 16 songs; 120 min; rated 2.2/5 by 5 [5]. Said about its sound: The soundboard runs badly fast and sharp: vocals are high-pitched and songs sound rushed, making the energy artificial; The soundboard needs serious pitch correction, with chipmunk-like speed; the audience recording better conveys how the show sounded [10][12]
- **gd78-12-27.aud-schug.warner.21480.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 165 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer prefers the really mellow versions from France '74 and Winterland '75 over this one [9]
- Reviewer found the second Golden Hall night special compared with the first, which was terrific [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-12-27.136705.sbd-aud.flac16**: source: Source 1: speed corrected version of shnid 9480: SBD>MR>??>DAT>CDR; Source 2: AUD MR Taped by Greg Schug, 2 Neumann SM69 mics (shnid 21480); Source 3:… [1]. Also: Three sources are combined to cover every note of the show [1]
- **gd1978-12-27.145346.sony.ecm270.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM-270 mics (section 404, row 8, seats 12-14) > Sony TC-158SD (TDK SA-C90) [2]. Also: Mark Severson supplied the master cassettes and Charlie Miller did the transfer and coordinated the effort; Joe B. Jones verified pitch [2]
- **gd78-12-27.sbd.wiley.9480.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [5]
- **gd78-12-27.aud-schug.warner.21480.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Greg Schug; source: Audience Recording: 2 Neumann SM69 mics [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by www.gratefulseconds.com: [San Diego Golden Hall, December 27, 1978](http://www.gratefulseconds.com/2018/12/san-diego-golden-hall-december-27-1978.html) [15]
